name: B10-0514/2025 (Verts/ALE) – Post-election killings and the deteriorating human rights situation in Tanzania, including the case of imprisoned opposition leader Tundu Lissu
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the post-election killings and deteriorating human rights situation in Tanzania, including the case of imprisoned opposition leader Tundu Lissu
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on Tanzania's October 2025 elections and the crackdown that followed. It condemns the killings and excessive force by security forces, and the arrests of opposition figures and critics. It asks Tanzania to release opposition leader Tundu Lissu and others held for peaceful activity, and to investigate the violence. It also asks the European Union to press Tanzania and support people at risk.

- No law changes; the Parliament only states its opinion and makes requests.
- It affects Tanzania's government, opposition figures, journalists and rights defenders.
- Next, the EU is asked to raise these concerns with Tanzania and watch Lissu's trial.
